# GroLabs

> AI-agent-driven optimization layer for small e-commerce businesses.
> GroLabs recovers revenue that merchants are already losing to three
> specific failure modes — customers who can't find the product they
> want, customers who find it but aren't convinced, and customers who
> are convinced but can't get through checkout.

GroLabs runs continuously on the merchant's existing storefront
(WooCommerce today, more platforms over time), detects leaks at every
funnel stage, and fixes them. The merchant pays a flat subscription
and the agent monitors / hunts leaks / proposes fixes so the operator
gets their time back.

## Who GroLabs is for

- Small-to-mid e-commerce stores on WooCommerce (other platforms next).
- Owner-operators who can't afford a full optimization team.
- Stores with at least a few thousand monthly sessions where small
  conversion lifts already produce meaningful dollar returns.

## The three failure modes GroLabs addresses

1. **Search conversion uplift** — internal site search. Industry
   benchmark: users who search convert 2–3× more often than those
   who don't, if they find what they want.
2. **Product page drop-off** — shoppers leave product pages without
   adding to cart. Industry benchmark: 14–23% of product page visits.
3. **Returns of perfect products** — products returned because the
   customer expected something different than what arrived. Industry
   benchmark: 19–24% of returns trace to mismatched expectations
   caused by incomplete product data or discovery issues.
